candidate.user_submission: The child is 59 months old. The child has cough or difficult breathing, but no diarrhoea, no ear problem, and no fever. The child is not convulsing now, and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. I counted the breaths for one full minute while the child was calm. Respiratory rate is 40 per minute. Chest indrawing is not present. Stridor is not present when the child is calm. There is no wheezing and no recurrent wheeze. A pulse oximeter is not available. The cough has lasted for 3 days.
